title: Wire telemetry events for Suggestions funnel + server-side API usage logging
author: Caleb Johnson
description: Context: For the Optimize Suggestions beta, we need a closed-loop funnel to understand which recommendations are useful and where users drop off (impression → expand → dismiss → apply-click). This PR wires client-side analytics events from the Console Suggestions list + details drawer, and adds server-side logging/metrics on the /optimize/suggestions API for usage + debugging (without collecting request/response bodies). Scope: (1) UI events: suggestions_impression, suggestion_expand, suggestion_dismiss, suggestion_apply_click; (2) API logs + counters: optimize_suggestions.list requests, result counts, latency buckets, authz denied; (3) shared schema helpers to keep event props consistent across UI and backend. Non-goals: no PII, no raw prompts/responses, no customer-level savings numbers in analytics events (those remain in product surfaces only). Event properties (UI): org_id (hashed), project_id (hashed), route_id (stable), model_id, suggestion_id (stable), suggestion_type (batching|caching), risk_level (low|medium|high), confidence_bucket (low|med|high), rank_in_list, list_sort, filter_state, region, ui_surface (suggestions_table|details_drawer). Event properties (API): org_id (hashed), project_id (hashed), endpoint (/optimize/suggestions), http_status_class, authz_result (allow|deny), page_size, returned_count, stale_as_of_present (true|false), sort_key. Privacy: org/project identifiers are hashed at the client boundary before emission; suggestion_id is a stable ID already surfaced in the UI and does not contain tenant-identifying info. Sampling: impressions sampled at 20% by default (configurable) to reduce volume; expand/dismiss/apply-click are unsampled. Rollout: behind feature flag optimize_suggestions_beta; events only emit when the flag is enabled and the Suggestions page is rendered. Testing: added unit tests for schema normalization, and Playwright coverage for emitting expand/dismiss/apply-click from the drawer. Related: aligns with dashboards work in observability-pack (PR #1843) and supports the beta funnel dashboard spec.
commits: telemetry(console): add Suggestions analytics event constants + schema normalizer
console: emit impression events on Suggestions table render (with sampling + debouncing)
console: emit expand/dismiss/apply-click events from details drawer interactions
api(optimize): add request logging + metrics for /optimize/suggestions list endpoint
telemetry: add server-side authz denied counter + structured log fields
tests: add unit tests for event payload validation + Playwright event assertions
docs(internal): add notes for event taxonomy + privacy guardrails
ci_summary: Checks: console-lint (pass), console-unit (pass), console-e2e-playwright (pass), optimize-suggestions-unit (pass), backend-lint (pass), typecheck (pass). Notable: first Playwright run flaked on drawer timing; fixed by waiting on telemetry mock flush and reran successfully.
review_conversation: Allison Grant: Please ensure we have a single source of truth for event names and that the UI and API schemas match the dashboards spec (especially risk/confidence buckets). Also, can we avoid emitting raw org_id/project_id? Caleb Johnson (author): Updated to use hashed_org_id/hashed_project_id via existing telemetry helper; also moved event names into shared constants and added a schema normalizer with tests. Logan Wright: Impression sampling is good, but we need to de-dupe impressions on pagination/sort changes; otherwise impressions will explode. Also add a property to differentiate list vs drawer surface. Caleb Johnson (author): Added debounced impression emission keyed by (suggestion_id, view_session_id) and included ui_surface. Pagination/sort changes now emit new impressions only for newly visible rows. Nadia Rahman: Please confirm we are not sending savings estimates or token costs to analytics; those numbers can be sensitive and also unstable during beta. Caleb Johnson (author): Confirmed; events include only type/risk/confidence and list rank + filter/sort context. No savings/cost fields. Marcus Lin: Add a short comment in code about why suggestion_id is safe to emit and ensure we don’t log query params that could include route names with customer identifiers. Caleb Johnson (author): Added comments + server-side logger now redacts query params; only logs page_size, sort_key enum, returned_count, status class. Dylan Brooks: UI wiring looks good. Can we align dismiss reasons with the product spec? Right now it’s just 'dismissed'. Caleb Johnson (author): Added dismiss_reason enum (not_relevant|already_configured|testing_later|other) and wired the existing modal options. Approvals: Logan Wright approved after last push; Nadia Rahman approved; Allison Grant approved with note to keep sampling configurable; Marcus Lin approved after redaction change; Dylan Brooks approved.
